yt.title: A 32-bit hash collides after only {c_n} items #Shorts
yt.description:
For a 32-bit hash ({c_space} values), 50% collision probability after about sqrt(2 ln2 x 2^32) = {c_n} items (birthday bound).
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: A thirty two bit hash has over four billion possible values. It still collides fast.

scenes.label: items until two likely share a hash
scenes.narration: After only about {c_n_say} items, there is a fifty percent chance that two share a value.
It is the same birthday paradox. Collisions appear far sooner than the total number of values suggests.
